comparator.name: Public Administration and Organization Science
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted 2026–27 OER annex III specifies ten 6-EC first-year modules, eight 6-EC compulsory second-year Besturen modules plus two separate 6-EC Social Sciences for Society restricted choices, and third-year 30 EC genuinely open profiling space, 6 EC Besturen van de samenleving, 12 EC empirical research practicum, and 12 EC independent bachelor project. The first officially listed choice is instantiated in each separate restricted slot. Zero-credit mentorship and diagnostic language assessment do not contribute to the 180 EC. The 2026–27 regulations replace older bachelor-workgroup modules and EU Governance / Recht voor besturen en organiseren titles, so historical charts are not carried forward. Re-audit verifies the same 24-component180EC Besturen pathway and neutral official-order route choice. Research-practicum entry follows participation in Quantitative Methods; bachelorproject entry requires passed Governance or Consultancy Practicum and90EC from Years1–2. The bachelorproject is an individual academic paper and oral theoretical/methodological defense of results generated in the group research practicum, not a second independent empirical project. Year3 mentorship completion conditions project grade award. The Dutch diagnostic/remedial language sequence is part of Academic Skills and must be passed before its grade is awarded; no extra EC. Mandatory tutorials/practicals and elective-level/approval rules apply.

alternatives.label: Public governance, institutions and policy
alternatives.concept: Combines political institutions, constitutional and European law, public economics, sociology and research methods to examine collective decisions and policy implementation. Organisational behaviour and sustainability governance are present without claiming the VU specialist practicum or thesis.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum is anchored in politics, law, economics and research on public decisions; its limited leadership and sustainability courses are supporting applications.
progression: Current formal prerequisites and all covered-term offerings verified. Research/statistics and entrepreneurship precede their formal dependents; legal gateway precedes constitutional law; sustainability gateways precede required technical courses. Year1PPD; sensible foundations retained without inventing extra prerequisites.

alternatives.label: Organizational leadership, change and responsible decisions
alternatives.concept: Studies organizational culture, leadership, stakeholder negotiation, digital change and communication through substantive management, social psychology and empirical social methods. Ethical theory and the philosophy of emotion supply explicit foundations for examining responsibility, rationality, motivation and conflict. They are complementary foundations, not workplace consulting methods or a guarantee of merger projects. Comparative constitutional and administrative law adds specific attention to public authority, participation, remedies and procedural fairness.
alternatives.labelReason: Leadership, organizational psychology, strategy, social methods and communication remain central. Ethics and emotion theory replace unrelated literary production; the label reflects responsible organizational decisions rather than promising specialist creative communication. Constitutional and administrative accountability strengthens the public-institutional dimension; overlapping general rhetoric is omitted.

alternatives.label: Climate science, sustainability and public governance
alternatives.concept: Asks how public decisions can respond to climate and environmental challenges. Politics, constitutional and European law, public economics, sociology, justice and research methods provide a substantial social-science foundation. Climate, water, biodiversity, circularity, materials and energy courses supply scientific and technical content for evaluating policy options. These domain courses do not reproduce public-management training, organizational consultancy or the VU research sequence.

The label makes that balance explicit; technical study is not public-management training.

routeSelection.basis: The generic bachelor has two confirmed 2026–27 routes, Besturen and Organiseren. Both represent one of the two defining halves of the field and neither is a neutral general route; the OER lists Besturen first. The first-listed route is chosen without reference to UCR course fit, preserving the shared core and the exact Besturen requirements.

selection.assessment: The closest public-governance route, the workplace change and digital-organisation route, and the climate-governance route arise from separate target-specific interest clusters and organise study around different questions. Each has a coherent 24-course curriculum, passes feasibility, and differs from each other by at least ten courses. Three is the maximum. Re-audit retains three only after actual-content/weight review: the organizational option removes literary stylistics and creative poetry/performance, adds ethical and emotion-theory foundations, and uses modern sociology before advanced civil-society study. The climate option is a distinct combined domain-science/public-governance pathway, not an assertion that chemistry or energy engineering replaces administration. No specific merger, HR credential, clinical, teacher or digital-society master outcome is guaranteed. Current repair replaces overlapping rhetoric in the organisational composition with comparative constitutional/administrative accountability; same concept retained. Pairwise differences remain11,10,16courses. Gender-inequality correspondence reconsidered from actual psychological safety/minority survey content, not the old DiversityManagement label.

notes.text: The VU route integrates public administration and organizational science with a dedicated methods sequence, Governance Practicum, client-based team research and an individual academic paper and defense. UCR offers substantial related disciplinary study, but does not automatically reproduce that complete professional and research sequence. Literary production, emotion theory and environmental technologies are not substitutes for it.

The climate alternative deliberately combines environmental science and technical options with social, legal, economic and governance study. Its materials, resource and energy courses supply domain knowledge rather than public-management methods. Optional independent research is additional to the displayed 180 EC and requires separate approval; it is not automatically the VU practicum or bachelor project.

audience.programmeDescription: VU Public Administration and Organization Science studies how governments, businesses and civil society make decisions, organize people and implement change. The Dutch bachelor combines political and organizational analysis, law, economics, communication and social research. This comparison shows the Besturen route, its open study space and linked team-research and individual-project sequence.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers three qualified directions: public governance and policy; organizational leadership and responsible decisions; and climate science with public governance. Each has a substantial social-science response to the field, with different priorities. Leadership uses specific ethical and emotion-theory foundations; the climate direction includes substantial scientific and technical study. These do not confer the same disciplinary degree, specialist practicum, linked team-research and individual-project sequence or automatic postgraduate eligibility.

curriculum.limitation: This Dutch, full-time pathway follows Besturen (Public Governance). Year 1 contains 60 EC of common courses. Year 2 combines 48 EC of required study with two separate 6-EC restricted choices, illustrated here by Beyond Gender Inequalities and AI & Society. Year 3 contains 30 EC of open choice, a 6-EC governance course, 12 EC of team research and a 12-EC individual project. The project develops a paper and oral defence from the team-research findings. Methods courses have sequential participation requirements; the bachelor project requires 90 EC from Years 1–2 and a passed Governance or Consultancy Practicum. Mentorship and the Dutch diagnostic/remedial language requirements add no separate credits; completion conditions apply before the relevant grades are awarded. Practicals and tutorials require attendance. The ordinary first-year study-advice threshold is 42 EC, subject to exceptions. Open choice requires approval except for specified options; it normally excludes introductory courses and must include at least 12 EC at level 300. A single 6-EC introductory prerequisite may be approved within a coherent package. Internships require prior approval, and overlapping minor content requires replacement.
